channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Wanted: Local dummies to replace imports in auto crash tests
item.description: Imported ADAS test dummies may not accurately represent Indian pedestrians and road users. The Automotive Research Association of India (ARAI) is now working on locally made alternatives, with research into materials, body measurements and design at the heart of the project.&nbsp;

item.title: Meta Platforms ordered to pay $25 billion in New Mexico consumer data protection case
item.description: New Mexico accused Meta of misleading Facebook users about who could access their personal data, how the company dealt with hate speech and misinformation, and other internal policies

item.title: ‘Remain vigilant’: Indian Embassy issues travel advisory for France amid violent protests, curfews | What we know
item.description: The Indian Embassy in France has urged nationals to remain vigilant amid violent protests over rising living costs, warning of localised curfews and transport disruptions. The advisory comes ahead of fresh demonstrations on October 24.

item.title: Punjab govt offices empty as employees, pensioners strike over pending DA, pension revision | Watch video
item.description: Punjab government employees announced a two-day protest across the state over administrative and monetary demands. It is held under the banner of the Punjab Employees and Pensioners Joint Front and the Joint Employees Platform Punjab.

item.title: Meet Kerala farmer who traded rubber for organic lemons. The payoff? ₹13 lakh in peak-season earnings | How he did it?
item.description: After nearly three decades working in the Gulf, Rajan Mathew returned to Kerala and replaced rubber cultivation with organic lemon farming. His 0.8-acre orchard produces around five tonnes of lemons annually, with prices reaching ₹260 per kg during peak demand.

item.title: Who is Stephen Hubbard? Why did Putin free the 74-year-old US teacher jailed as a Ukraine war ‘mercenary’? Explained
item.description: Russia has freed 74-year-old American teacher Stephen Hubbard, jailed on charges of fighting as a mercenary for Ukraine. President Vladimir Putin pardoned him on humanitarian grounds after US requests, as Trump’s envoy Witkoff visited Moscow for talks on ending the Ukraine war.

item.title: Who is Barbara Bush? Ex Prez George’s daughter donates lakhs for Democrat James Talarico’s Texas Senate race campaign
item.description: Barbara Bush, daughter of former US President George W. Bush, donated $2,500 to a PAC supporting Democrat James Talarico’s Texas Senate campaign. The publicly disclosed contribution drew attention amid her family’s Republican ties &amp; was described by a campaign finance expert as potentially symbolic.

item.title: Who is Amanda Peterson Corio? Google Energy Chief explains how AI data centres could help strengthen power grids
item.description: Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of data centre energy, says AI's rising electricity needs could also create opportunities to improve power grids. Flexible computing workloads can ease peak demand, support reliability and help limit costly infrastructure upgrades.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, wife donate $75 million to Vanderbilt University for new design college
item.description: The new institution will be named the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang College of Art, Architecture and Design. The campus is expected to open in 2027, subject to regulatory approvals, and will build on the legacy of the California College of the Arts

item.title: New Zealand FTA kicks in: Can zero tariffs boost India's exports? Which sectors stand to gain? Expert weighs in
item.description: India-New Zealand FTA could benefit exporters of engineering goods, automotive components, pharmaceuticals, textiles and processed foods. Protiviti India MD Saurav Kumar says zero-duty access could improve competitiveness, but sustained export growth will depend on pricing, quality, and logistics.

item.title: Gold loan boom brings early stress signals for NBFCs
item.description: While Bajaj Finance has seen stress in asset quality from short-tenure gold loans, Piramal Finance warned that a significant share of industry disbursements has gone to borrowers with a history of serious delinquencies.

item.title: Who is Scott Colom? Senate Majority PAC’s ₹11.3 cr ad campaign for him - Why is Mississippi Senate race difficult?
item.description: The Senate Majority PAC is spending $1.2 million on statewide ads backing Democrat Scott Colom against Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi. The ad slams Hyde-Smith’s legislative record and Medicaid votes.&nbsp;

item.title: Gurugram traffic crackdown: Motorcycle seized over 17 unpaid challans totalling ₹1.79 lakh
item.description: Gurugram Traffic Police seized a motorcycle near Maruti Kunj T-point after finding 17 pending traffic challans totalling ₹1.79 lakh. The violations included riding without a helmet and not having a valid Pollution Under Control certificate.

item.title: Job loss, rising costs: How Europe's economic slowdown is fuelling protests in Albania, honorary consul general explains
item.description: Albania is witnessing anti-government protests. The country’s honorary consul general, Dikshu Chandra Kukreja, links it to Europe’s economic slowdown, the Russia-Ukraine war, soaring energy costs and returning migrants, saying the grievances have widened beyond opposition to a resort project.&nbsp;

item.title: SBI data leak raises fraud risks as bank probes exposure of customer records
item.description: While the bank says its core systems and customer balances remain safe, cybersecurity experts warn that leaked personal information could fuel targeted fraud, social engineering and potentially further attacks.

item.title: Vishal Mega Mart’s value proposition faces a test as it reshapes strategy
item.description: The value retailer is freezing entry prices and testing smaller stores and premium formats to boost growth as a festive lag squeezes September-quarter margins.

item.title: France protests: A look at origin of ‘Bismillah, c’est les ténèbres’ slogan — in which other countries did it appear?
item.description: A bizarre French-Arabic phrase that surfaced in a Snapchat screenshot has become a protest slogan among students in France and elsewhere in Europe. Students use it to mock suspected undercover officers’ attempts to infiltrate protest groups, though the allegation has not been confirmed.

item.title: Centre to back agrivoltaics under PM KUSUM 2.0: MNRE secretary
item.description: The government plans to add 5 GW of dual-use agrisolar capacity over three years, targeting a 25% cost-neutralization subsidy to boost farm incomes and ease land constraints.

item.title: Piyush Goyal to visit Germany, Netherlands to boost trade, investment ties
item.description: India-EU goods trade totalled €118.4 billion in 2025, with EU imports from India amounting to €69.5 billion and exports to India at €48.9 billion. The scale of trade underscores the importance of expanding market access and investment opportunities as India and the EU pursue an FTA.

item.title: J&K MLA Shagun Parihar, Gujarat MP Hemang Joshi, UP's Nikhil Tiwari: Who are big names in BJP’s new youth wing team?
item.description: The BJP’s youth wing, BJYM, has announced a new national team led by Vadodara MP Hemang Joshi. Kishtwar MLA Shagun Parihar and Nikhil Mani Tiwari are among the vice-presidents, with appointments spanning several states ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.

item.title: Who is Jack Weis? Princeton PhD whose Nobel-cited research could not secure him a job after 2,300 applications
item.description: Jack Weis, a 30-year-old chemical engineering PhD from Princeton University, has applied for more than 2,300 jobs since graduating in 2024. Despite research cited by the 2024 Nobel Committee, he remains without stable employment.

item.title: Meet Kerala woman who turned ₹250 into mushroom business earning ₹90 lakh annually: Here's how she did it
item.description: Shije started mushroom farming with an investment of ₹250 in 2007. She and her husband, Thankachan, later launched Coon Fresh, expanding into mushroom cultivation, spawn sales, value-added products and training programmes.

item.title: Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, Neha Bora Detention: Who are Special Executive Magistrates, why are they in news after SIR
item.description: The detention of CJP activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, and a notice to AISA president Neha Bora, have spotlighted Special Executive Magistrates’ preventive powers amid SIR protests. The cases raise questions over procedural safeguards, peace bonds and the impact on personal liberty.

item.title: Argentina eases drug import rules, creating new export avenues for India
item.description: The new framework dismantles long-standing regulatory barriers for Indian manufacturers, enabling a direct export of Indian medicines, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and medical equipment to Tucumán and other provinces.

item.title: GRAP 1 restrictions, bans in Delhi: Impact on cars, trucks, PUC certificate, hotels, restaurants, construction
item.description: Air Quality lndex (AQI) of Delhi slipped to ‘poor’ on Wednesday. It is expected to remain the same in the upcoming days as per the predictions of the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology.

item.title: Delhi’s worsening air quality triggers Stage-I GRAP across NCR
item.description: Delhi’s AQI rose from 179 (moderate) on 20 October to 244 (poor) at 2pm on 21 October, according to the CAQM.

item.title: Beyond the great smog: A year-round silt crisis choking urban India
item.description: Winter smog makes headlines, but toxic road silt never settles. With dust loads in Indian urban areas up to 30 times above many global cities, the country’s clean air fight faces an invisible wall. A ground report from the dustbowl of Gurugram.

item.title: Why did CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka withdraw Delhi High Court plea against custody extension?
item.description: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka withdrew their plea challenging custody extension in the Delhi High Court after the court asked them to await a lower court's review of their sureties. They were detained after allegedly climbing barricades at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Who is Vishal Rattewal? CA and social media influencer sued by Niva Bupa over posts seeking ₹5 crore in damages
item.description: The Delhi High Court imposed a token cost of ₹1 on Niva Bupa Health Insurance after the insurer’s ₹5 crore suit against social media influencer Vishal Rattewal was found unsuitable for the court’s Intellectual Property Division.&nbsp;

item.title: GRAP-1 curbs imposed in Delhi-NCR as air quality deteriorates to ‘poor’
item.description: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has invoked Stage-I of GRAP after Delhi’s Air Quality Index (AQI) rose to 238 at 10 am on Wednesday, as per multiple reports.

item.title: Who is Paul Mackenzie? Kenya cult leader convicted of 190 deaths after children were starved to ‘meet Jesus’ | Profile
item.description: Kenya cult leader Paul Mackenzie Mackenzie was linked to more than 400 deaths and convicted Monday of murdering 190 children and one adult after ordering followers to starve themselves to death to meet Jesus.

item.title: Aneet Padda turns showstopper for Amit Aggarwal at Lakmē Fashion Week finale
item.description: Aneet Padda turns showstopper for Amit Aggarwal at Lakmē Fashion Week Grand Finale, showcasing the AM:IT collection and Lakmē's 5PM Glam Reset.

item.title: One crop changed everything: Meet the Maharashtra farmer who clocks ₹2 crore annual turnover by selling fruits
item.description: Mahesh Asabe’s family began growing dragon fruit on three acres in Solapur in 2013-14. With agricultural training, drip irrigation and farm ponds, Rukmini Farms has since expanded to 60 acres.&nbsp;

item.title: Reliance shares proud moment! Dhirubhai Ambani International ranks 9 in IB schools globally; only Indian school on list
item.description: Dhirubhai Ambani International School ranked ninth in Education Advisers UK’s 2026 global IBDP rankings, Reliance Industries said. The only Indian school in the top 10, DAIS recorded its highest-ever average of 40.8 points.

item.title: ₹40,000 salary as engineer vs ₹1 lakh earning as Rapido driver: Rider reveals why he left previous job; what changed
item.description: A Jharkhand woman’s conversation with a Rapido driver made her rethink success. The former engineer said he changed careers to better support his family and live in his hometown. Shared on social media, the encounter challenged the idea that degrees and corporate jobs alone define a fulfilling life.
